entities.summary: Halim Ebo, also known as (Arabic: عبد الحليم عبو), Abd Elhalim Mohamed Abou and Abou Abd Elahim, is an Egyptian indoor volleyball player. With his club Al-Ahly Sporting Club he competed at the 2011 FIVB Volleyball Men's Club World Championship. Since 2013 he is a member of the Egypt men's national volleyball team. He competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics and 2014 World Championships and 2015 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Cup
